  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as july_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as august_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as september_orders
FROM orders

  COUNT(oi.order_id) as order_count,

JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

ORDER BY order_count DESC

    customer_address,
    customer_city,
    customer_state,
    customer_zip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as order_count
